## Orientation

Work in /home/ayin/se-workflow. Create scripts/session_metrics.py and tests/test_session_metrics.py. Run tests with python3 -m pytest. tests/conftest.py needs the adaptive-artifacts CLI at ~/adaptive-artifacts, so keep the new test file free of store access. Stream each file line by line. One real transcript file can be very large and a full scan can exceed 120 seconds. Do not edit .artifacts/ or other tests.
